title: Vic's Games
tagline: Little worlds to explore — playable on phone or computer. Pick one and dive in. ✨

games.title: Warbound: Orcs & Humans
games.desc: A classic pixel-art real-time strategy: mine gold, chop lumber, raise an army and battle the enemy.

games.title: Warbound HD
games.desc: The same war, redrawn in a crisper, higher-definition style. Same build-and-battle gameplay.

games.title: Warbound: Remastered
games.desc: A cinematic remaster with HDR bloom, dust, film grain and a golden battle UI.

games.title: Aethermoor
games.desc: An original third-person 3D action-RPG: explore a glowing world, fight, quest and level up. (Needs internet.)

games.title: Sparklehoof's Meadow
games.desc: A gentle, no-fail magical game for little ones: ride a unicorn, collect sparkles, cast magic, and play kind counting & spelling quests with Twinkle the fairy. Add it to your home screen to play offline!
